ownerOverride.note: Schedule changes require CALENDAR_OWNER_PIN in .env — only Rob overrides hard rules.

autoProduction.note: production_cron fires calendar slots without dashboard clicks. Long-form skipped when avatar/HeyGen blocked.

live: Twitch TV: transformative produced video only (Bobby G commentary VODs + news desk). No streamer clip comps, no 4-up grid rebroadcast.
YouTube Live: follow dayparts from this calendar — event_night → news_desk (when day-fresh VOD exists) → grid.
Live overrides require owner PIN — agents and automation cannot change the calendar without it.
vod: Long-form VOD: publish YouTube after Gate 5 QA pass (direct API when enabled, else Upload-Post).
Shorts: 3/day at fixed slots — Twitch 5pm, News 6pm, bonus 7pm — YouTube + TikTok + Instagram via Upload-Post.
Scheduled publish: job holds at publish_scheduled until slot time; cron fires Gate 5 automatically.
NBA long-form and shorts: OFF until NFL prep (August) unless owner override.
